answer: Standing is a marble that only counts when a stranger holds it: each epoch’s work must be verified by an established peer who stakes their own standing on its truth — a sable only lifts when a stranger holds the marble, and an inlet only lets in work that a stranger holds. A farm of a thousand fakes cannot stake on each other’s work: their standing is fake, so staking it risks nothing, and no established stranger stakes real standing on a fake’s work — and one epoch of unstaked work adds nothing.
